research_goal: Close the gap between P81's pure caller-fed recorder and a testable reset/do single-episode source session, preserving no-replay and no-future information; NO genuine external first-use in this engineering gate.

source_software.task_regime: LearningRegime.do or other do-permitted, never ctf_do
source_software.info_action: CartPoleWindPCH.do() reports actual action under info['action']

driver.stage_only: TOY_TESTED_INJECTED_SESSION_IMPLEMENTATION, real external env gate remains CLOSED
driver.caller_supplied_session: object exposing reset(seed=...), do(callable), close() optional; allowed only for in-memory fake toy fixture from test scope, never call owner source in this gate
driver.preconditions: Explicit source_kind='toy_engineering'; split in FIT/CAL; all IDs valid; no upstream import; no standalone CLI; no network; validate before session.reset() or .do(); disallowed external/physical must fail before touching source
driver.one_shot: reset exactly once with frozen P81 episode seed; do exactly once per planned observed event; no see/ctf_do/step calls; callback returns frozen discrete 0/1
driver.semantic_guard: Check exact returned 5-tuple (nextstate4,reward,terminated_bool,truncated_bool,info_dict) and info['action']==planned; reject float/bool misuse and any hidden-mode override; record outcome after do() with receipt only
driver.uncertain_effects: Any exception after reset/do is terminal abort; no retry, no compensation call, never reuse same session; close exactly once after terminal/abort, but no close if pre-admission failed; if close() fails after actual effect, error recorded and not retried
driver.short_episodes: If fewer than two witnessed true transitions, no padded success; retain failure/no external score
driver.output: exact P81 toy fixture record and P80/P79 offline schema, never external-source report; no model predictions, no training, no artifact library write
driver.expected_resource: single CPU thread, low resource, zero paid API and GPU use

tests: Admitted mock reset/do produces exactly 2 factual steps and correct P80/P79 schema
Default unknown/external/physical source rejected before touching session
Forbidden split/episode index/custody rejected before reset
One reset, one do per observed action, one close, no see/ctf_do/step
Actual info action mismatch or absent raises, abort, never retry or next step
Exception from do marks uncertain action and does not retry, close once
Unexpected do() 5-tuple types and nonfinite observations/reward rejected
Pending action mismatch and stop after termination
Float32/NumPy-like state tolist accepted as action-free conversion, no hidden info output
No uncontrolled repo/library/network modifications or owner workflow calls
Exact-head full G4 CPU Windows/Linux and G5 authentic TTT Windows/Linux and G7 pinned Mamba2 CPU qualified, no heldout science
